paper.title: Table-Critic: A Multi-Agent Framework for Collaborative Criticism and Refinement in Table Reasoning
paper.central_claim: Table-Critic is a four-agent (Judge, Critic, Refiner, Curator) framework for iterative critique and refinement of table-reasoning chains with a self-evolving template tree that accumulates critique knowledge, improving accuracy, error correction and degradation over baselines at 1.8-2.2x base cost.

evidence.support_explanation: Retained object: a template tree of critique patterns.

evidence.quote: they often lack effective mechanisms to identify and correct errors in intermediate reasoning steps, leading to cascading error propagation.

claims.text: Table-Critic outperforms decomposition and critique baselines on WikiTQ/TabFact across three LLMs
claims.setting: Chain-of-Table initial chains; Qwen2.5-72B, LLaMA3.3-70B, GPT-4o-mini
claims.baseline_control: End-to-End, Few-Shot, Binder, Dater, Chain-of-Table, Critic-CoT (re-implemented on same chains)
claims.selection_vs_test: tree evolves on the evaluated stream; no labels used
claims.result_denominator: WikiTQ 4,344 / TabFact 2,024; averages 73.7 vs 67.4 and 91.7 vs 89.5; single greedy run
claims.allowed_conclusion: Large, consistent accuracy gains over reproduced baselines under greedy decoding; no uncertainty estimates.

claims.text: Higher error-correction and lower solution-degradation than Critic-CoT
claims.allowed_conclusion: Supported for the Qwen backbone; failures are counted.

claims.text: Self-evolving template tree accumulates critique knowledge that improves later reflections
claims.selection_vs_test: no separation; tree grows on the evaluated stream
claims.result_denominator: +1.1 WikiTQ, +1.8 TabFact; single run; tree contents unreported
claims.allowed_conclusion: A small stream-level gain from template accumulation; most gain comes from the multi-turn critique/refine loop.

claims.text: Better than majority voting at comparable cost
claims.allowed_conclusion: Supported on token-matched comparison; cost table has a likely typo.

assessment.strongest_supported_claim: A Judge-gated, label-free template tree that grows over the evaluated question stream improves later questions by 1.1-1.8 points over a static 2-template tree (Qwen2.5-72B, single run); the larger gains over Chain-of-Table (+8-9 WikiTQ) come mainly from the multi-turn critique/refine loop and beat compute-matched self-consistency.

G.reason: Names the fixed component (critique knowledge elicited from inherent LLM ability) and a residue measured in its own data (Critic-CoT degradation -4.9%), with neighbors listed; neighbor originals and the 'first multi-agent' claim unverified.

M.reason: Design choices are tied to stated observations (first-error focus, prefix-only refiner, curation only after verified correction, tree routing) and predict lower degradation, which is then measured; weakness is that the gate and critic are the same LLM family without a reliability check.

X.reason: Roles, I/O, algorithms, edit vocabulary, initialization, K and decoding are specified and prompts are shown; persistence across questions, ordering, tree growth/pruning, similarity thresholds and rollback are not, so retention behavior is only partly reconstructable.

E.measurement.reason: Standard accuracy on full WikiTQ/TabFact test sets plus correction/degradation rates relative to the base chain; the verifier is gold labels, not the Judge.

E.causality.reason: Compute-matched self-consistency, same-chain Critic-CoT and a static-tree ablation are good controls, but the tree ablation is one backbone and one run, no Judge/Curator/routing/alternative-store ablations, and the retained part is only ~1-2 of ~9 gained points.

E.holdout.reason: Label-free sequential updates avoid answer leakage, but the tree is built on the same stream it is scored on with no construction/evaluation split or ordering report; initial templates authored; no contamination discussion.

E.statistics.reason: Full-size test sets, three backbones and counted degradation failures give a consistent direction, but single greedy runs with no intervals, seeds or ordering variance.

E.cost.reason: Token cost with derivation (1.87x/2.19x) and compute-matched SC up to 15 samples; deductions: tokens only (no dollars/latency/call counts) and the TabFact row does not satisfy the stated cost formula.

rationale: Strong, compute-matched gains mostly from the critique loop; the retained tree adds 1.1-1.8 points on the same stream, self-gated, single run.
